suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 (GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp) is unsafe deserialization of untrusted Kotlin build-cache metadata. GHSA lists exactly one affected Maven package: org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin < 2.4.20-Beta1. NVD instead encodes a single coarse cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin with versionEndExcluding 2.4.20, so every artifact in the org.jetbrains.kotlin group below 2.4.20 matches, and NVD re-scored it 9.8 CRITICAL (JetBrains, the CNA, scores it 6.7: AV:L/AC:H/PR:H). kotlin-reflect 1.6.10 can never be remediated: kotlin-compiler-embeddable (still as of 2.4.20) hard-pins it, so it resolves on kotlinCompilerClasspath, kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath and kotlinKlibCommonizerClasspath whatever Kotlin version we use. These are build-time only and not published, and kotlin-reflect contains no build-cache code; suppressed indefinitely. Added: 2026-09-25

CVE-2026-53914 on the rest of the org.jetbrains.kotlin group (see the kotlin-reflect entry above for the CPE over-match). The Kotlin Gradle plugin is on the fixed 2.4.20, and the kotlin-reflect and kotlin-stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 stragglers from jackson-module-kotlin and AGP are constrained to it in plugin/build.gradle.kts. What remains is the Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler, stdlib and reflect that rewrite-kotlin puts on rewriteDependencies and testRuntimeClasspath; openrewrite/rewrite#8914 (merged 2026-09-25) moves rewrite-kotlin to 2.4.20. This window lets that propagate. Anything still matching after the expiry should be fixed, not suppressed. Added: 2026-08-24

False positive. CVE-2020-29582 (GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq, MODERATE 5.3) is insecure permissions on temporary files, and both the advisory text ("In JetBrains Kotlin before 1.4.21") and GHSA scope it to org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib <= 1.4.20, fixed in 1.4.21. NVD's CPE range is erroneously widened to cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin versionEndExcluding 2.1.0, which is why kotlin-reflect:1.6.10 matches here despite carrying the fix. Provenance: kotlin-reflect:1.6.10 is hard-pinned by kotlin-compiler-embeddable and resolves only on the Kotlin Gradle plugin's internal kotlinCompilerClasspath, kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath and kotlinKlibCommonizerClasspath configurations. It is not on runtimeClasspath and is not published. The advisory is permanently scoped to Kotlin < 1.4.21, so the versions we resolve can never become a true positive for this CVE; suppressed indefinitely. Added: 2026-08-24
